title: Post-quantum TLS and ECH as a step shift for network security monitoring: testbed, flow data and evaluation code
description: Testbed, derived flow tables, per-flow predictions and evaluation code accompanying the manuscript 'Crypto-agility breaks the baseline: post-quantum TLS and Encrypted Client Hello as a step shift for network security monitoring' (the manuscript itself is not included). A factorial Mininet testbed (Go/TCP, OpenSSL/TCP and Go/QUIC; classical or hybrid X25519MLKEM768 key exchange; ECDSA or ML-DSA-65 certificates; ECH off or on; 24 cells) replays seeded benign and malicious TLS workloads. Flow detectors trained on pre-migration traffic (LightGBM, random forest, MLP, Isolation Forest, byte-level CNN, JA3/JA4) are tested after each migration, together with eight repairs and an uneven-migration experiment.
